title: Automatic condensed l-adic linearity into bounded torsion
statement: For a prime l, a scheme X, and modules M,T over the pulled-back condensed ring of l-adic integers [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category], every additive sheaf map M.X -> T.X is linear if l^r kills T.X, for any natural r. The reduction cokernel is [lem-pur-condensed-zl-reduction-mod-ell-power].

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: The pulled-back reduction modulo l^r is the cokernel of multiplication by l^r. Its constant cyclic target is generated by the unit, so the unit and multiplication by l^r jointly give an epimorphism onto the integral ring sheaf.

Tensor that epimorphism with the source module. The linearity defect vanishes on the unit by the module unit axiom, and on the other summand because l^r kills the target. Apply Mod.act_comp_eq_of_epi.
